# Agent Three R

## When to use
Decide whether to reuse, script, temporarily delegate or create an agent. Use when a capability gap or agent proposal arises.

## Inputs
Task objective, constraints, supporting evidence, assigned owner, and available tools.

## Procedure
1. Test Repetitive, Rule-based and Return independently.
2. Compare to existing registry, one-time workflows and simple scripts.
3. Document maintenance and benchmark costs as assumptions until measured.
4. Propose permanent creation only if all criteria warrant it.

## Expected output
3R decision and justification. Include `TASK_ID`, evidence, uncertainty and next handoff when applicable.

## Failure and escalation
If information or permission is missing, mark BLOCKED and identify the dependency. Never invent a verification, token measurement, tool call or approval. Consult `CLAUDE.md` and `docs/CONTRACT.md`.
